lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a structured grid pattern posterior to the pectoral fin, forming approximately five visible vertical columns and four horizontal rows of local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white spots, creating a lattice-like arrangement where spots act as vertex nodes at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 18-22 high-luminance spots are distributed within the mask of the first dorsal fin, with a higher spatial frequency observed in the central-posterior region compared to the leading edge.
